title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
abstract: arXiv:2611.23225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. translated_title: StringQFT：一个面向AI辅助理论物理的多用途教科书资源
translated_abstract: 我们提出StringQFT，它既是一套关于量子场论弦构造的教科书合集，也是AI辅助理论物理的基础设施。该合集包含18卷、190章、3,795页，内容涵盖膜探针、膜网络、几何工程、F理论构造、包裹M5膜以及精确世界面构造。其开卷基准题库包含1,073道题目，其中499道支持有限答案的自动检查。对于检索增强生成，它提供了1,371条与教科书来源及PDF位置相关联的章节记录，并配备本地词法检索器。训练数据准备通过21个私有的、与来源关联的示例加以说明。对于智能体，它提供了19个具有指定输入和有限定义域的计算工具，将工具使用与教科书推导相连接。我们通过具体问题、检索到的段落和有限计算来展示这些用途。
tldr: 该论文提出StringQFT——一套涵盖18卷、3795页的量子场论弦构造教科书合集，同时作为AI辅助理论物理的基础设施，提供开卷基准题库、检索增强生成资源、训练数据示例以及智能体计算工具。
en_tdlr: The paper presents StringQFT, an 18-volume, 3,795-page textbook collection on string constructions of quantum field theory that doubles as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics, offering open-book benchmarks, retrieval-augmented generation resources, training data examples, and agent calculation tools.
